Notes: Using dimorphic.subset.list.txt as the final consistently sex-specific splicing (SSS) set from Grieshop et al. (2025). (2024a), then retained only if male and female splicing profiles remained concordant with the Mishra reference profiles across three additional Mishra et al. (2024b) populations.
